g.title: Text or scanned. A page counts as scanned when it has almost no text; OCR kicks in when more than 30 percent of pages are scanned.
PyMuPDF Tesseract integration produces a temporary text-layer PDF at 300 DPI. Without Tesseract installed it logs and carries on.

Upstream is_list_item always returned false and a list_not_table flag was dropped along the call chain, so lists became invisible tables. Two monkey-patches fix both, applied once per process, instead of forking an unmaintained project.
Each pass has its own error handling, so a failure in one never costs the fixes from the others. On a sample: 0 to 9 real list items and 0 to 3 clickable links.

Splits list items out of merged paragraphs, detects nesting from indentation and applies Word list styles. Lettered and roman lists get generated OOXML numbering definitions, and a sequence-reset check keeps headings like 4. Results as headings.
Finds http, https, ftp, www and mailto text inside runs and replaces it with real w:hyperlink elements with external relationships.
Maps missing fonts by name first, then by Unicode range: CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari and Cyrillic.
